title: Allostatic Precision-Gated Ignition (APGI): Simulation and Analysis Codebase
description: Companion code and synthetic seed datasets for the APGI paper series (Papers 1–4). Implements core APGI equations (Sₜ, θₜ, Πⁱ_eff), a Liquid Neural Network extension (Paper 2), a five-level hierarchical architecture (Paper 3), parameter recovery, clinical DoC interpretation, and all figure-generation scripts. Includes the deterministic generator for nine synthetic seed datasets (sim0–sim8; regenerate with python data/generate_seeds.py) covering HEP proxy validation, ignition dynamics, parameter recovery, LNN reservoir trajectories, hierarchical prediction-error series, disorder-of-consciousness biomarkers, LNN bifurcation signatures, the metabolic crossover and the causal TMS design; data/seeds/seed_manifest.json records each file's SHA-256, seed and alignment with protocol specification v1.1.0.
notes: To reproduce all figures from locally regenerated seeds: bash reproduce_all.sh --local. To regenerate seed datasets: python data/generate_seeds.py (the master seed is fixed in data/generate_seeds.py; python data/generate_seeds.py --verify checks them against data/checksums.sha256). Individual figure-generation scripts (figures/v1_0/protocols/pK_*.py and figures/v1_1/generate.py) each use their own fixed, documented seed and do not share MASTER_SEED.
